title: Shaktiyan Kaam Karna Band Kyun Ho Jaati Hain? — 4 Galtiyan Jo Sadhak Ko Kabhi Nahi Karni Chahiye base

segments.text: Bhaiya Ka Gyaan — Knowledge Base Topic: Sadhna/Shaktiyan Kaam Karna Kyun Band Ho Jaati Hain (4 Common Galtiyan) Source: Bhaiya k a satsang/discussion session (video transcript, ~1hr 12min) P urpose: Chatbot knowledge — users k o guide k arne ke liye ki unki sadhna/shakti/drishti k yun ruk gayi aur k ya NAHI k arna hai. 1. CORE PROBLEM (Yeh session kis baare mein hai) Jo log bhakti k ar rahe hain — R am k a jaap, "Jai Siya R am" k a jap, niyamit sadhna, shakti jagrit ki hui hai — unme se k uch logon k e saath yeh hota hai: Kaam achanak rukne lagta hai ya ekdum band ho jaata hai Drishti (spiritual vision) ekdum band ho jaati hai Shaktiyon k a asar k am ho jaata hai Physically, ﬁnancially, mentally dobara dikk at aane lagti hai Bhaiya ne aise sabhi cases ki case study ki (Baba se poochk ar), aur har case mein 4 common galtiyan mili. In 4 k e alawa 5th k oi case banta hi nahi (e xception ho sakta hai, par woh bahut rare hai — "e xceptions ar e always ther e", woh individual case hota hai). Key philosophy: Har vyakti sikhaata hai k ya KARNA hai. P ar agar aapk o pata pad jaaye ki k ya NAHI k arna hai, to aap bahut k uch seekh jaoge. Promise: Jo yeh 4 galtiyan nahi k arta, usk e upar Gurudev ki aisi mahima r ehti hai ki brahmand ki koi bhi shakti usk e saamne nahi tik egi — yahan tak ki Narayan tattva bhi nahi. (Gurudev k o sakshi maank ar bola gaya hai.) 2. AASHRAY KA WORKING MODEL (System kaise kaam karta hai) Yeh samajhna zar oori hai k yunki saari galtiyan isi model se r elated hain:

End-to-End Connection Aashray mein har insaan k o individually , directly Gurudev (Hanuman Ji Maharaj) se joda jaata hai — kabhi bhi bhaiya k e through nahi. Isliye yahan guru parampara hai hi nahi ("hamar e guru Hanuman Ji Maharaj hain to hum aapk e guru banenge" — aisa k abhi nahi hota). Ek end par aap ho, doosr e end par Guru ki shakti hai. Beech mein k oi aur connection NAHI hai. Jab bhi vyakti sank alp k e saath, vachano k e saath aavahan k arta hai (deepak lagata hai, prarthana k arta hai), to udhar ki shakti turant answer/r evert deti hai. Password & Portal Concept (sabse important metaphor) End-to -end connection mein har vyakti k o ek alag password diya jaata hai (astrally). Jaise hi woh passwor d lagate ho, ek portal khulta hai — wahan se shaktiyan jaati hain aur aati hain. That's all. Aapki vidhi, aapka sankalp, aapk e mantra, aapk e ghar k e niyam = aapka password. Agar aapne kisi k o apni vidhi/sank alp/remedy bata di → aapne apna passwor d de diya → us vyakti k o aapk e ghar ki saari shaktiyon k a access mil gaya. Kalyan Lok System Ghar mein deepak lagak ar prarthana: "He Hanuman Ji Maharaj, jitni bhi negativity hai un sabko mal sahit baandhit k arke Kalyan L ok bhej diya jaaye — Bhaiya k o sakshi maank ar prarthana k arta/k arti hoon." Shaktiyan turant negativity k o baandhk ar Kalyan L ok bhej deti hain — by default yahi hota hai. Guru vachan itna str ong hai ki bhaiya k o sakshi maank ar Hanuman Ji Maharaj k o samarpit kiya gaya deepak/bhog hamesha Hanuman Ji Maharaj tak hi jaa yega — brahmand ki k oi shakti beech mein nahi aa sakti. (P ar usk a RETURN gif t inter cept ho sakta hai — dekho Case 2.) 3. GALTI #1 — EMPATH / KARUNAMAYI LOG (Apni vidhi doosron ko baant dena) Kaun log Empathetic people ("empaths") — mann mein bahut k aruna hoti hai, har vyakti k o daya k e bhaav se dekhte hain.

Sochte hain: "Bechara R avi itne dar d mein hai, isk o Jai Siya R am k e baar e mein pata hi nahi hoga, k yun na main isk o naam de doon / vidhi bata doon / r emedy bata doon." Ya: "Isk e paas paise nahi hain Aashray join k arne ke, to chhoti si r emedy bata dete hain." Kya galat hota hai (mechanism) 1. Aapk a Guru se end-to -end connection hai; aapne teesr e vyakti k o apni vidhi/mantra/sank alp bata diya = apna password de diya . 2. Ab Guru ki shakti to aapk e channel se hi aayegi, par aap woh urja aage baant rahe ho — jo urja A APKE hisse aani thi, woh us teesr e vyakti k e paas jaayegi. 3. Ulta traﬃc bhi aapk e through hi chalega: jab us vyakti ki negativity/malinta Kalyan L ok jaayegi, woh bhi aapk e through jaayegi — uski pr oblems aapk o jhelni padengi. 4. Result: aapk e paas urja bachegi hi nahi. Aap "beech k e bandar" bank ar reh jaoge — na idhar ke na udhar k e. 5. Jisko aapne bataya usk a kaam ho jaayega (uski prarthana poor n hogi), par aapka band ho jaayega — aapk e upar kripa aani band ho jaayegi. Important note Kitni bhi zyada supply/urja mentor ya Aashray se badha di jaaye, aapk a kabhi bhar ega nahi — kyunki aap dir ectly aage baant rahe ho . ("Phata pet" — kitna bhi daalo, bharta nahi.) Aise vyakti hamesha dar d mein r ehte hain — drishti khoti hai, urja khoti hai, k arobar khone lagta hai; physically, ﬁnancially, mentally dikk at. Shaktiyan kisi k o chhodna nahi chahtin — aapne passwor d de diya to woh 100% aayengi. Kya karna chahiye (correct behaviour) Kisi k o jodna hai to directly bolo : "Yeh Aashray hai, hum isse k arte hain, tum bhi jud jao" — khud beech mein mat aao . Aashra y join karne k e liye kisi k o bhi bol sakte ho — yeh bilk ul galat NAHI hai. Bas apni shaktiyon k a access — apni prarthanaayein, sank alp, vidhi — mat batao . That's all. "Jisko bulana hoga woh dharti phaad k e aayega, space se bhi aa jaayega" — bhagwan khud jodne k a intezaam k ar lete hain. "Udta teer mat lo" — doosr on ki samasya apne upar lek ar unhe apna tatva mat do . Fix (agar galti ho chuki hai) Apne mentor k o phone/contact karo taaki ghar ka password badla ja sak e. Saare passwor ds badalne padenge, sabk o nik aalna padega — usk e baad aapki urja aap tak rahegi. Otherwise "you ar e totally in a mess" — batata rahega.

4. GALTI #2 — HAR MANDIR MEIN LET JAANA (Har jagah samarpan bhaav se pranam) Kaun log Jinko bhagwan se bahut pyaar hai — raaste mein k oi bhi mandir mila (Shiv mandir, Shani mandir ...) wahin dandavat/let gaye, samarpan bhaav se pranam k ar diya. Unki galti nahi hai — humein yahi sikhaya gaya hai. P ar: "Tum R am k e ho, tum sabk e ho jao" — yeh baat sirf tumhe pata hai, saamne wale k o nahi; woh apne hisaab se chalta hai. Kya galat hota hai (mechanism) 1. Har mandir mein bhagwan nahi hote. (Bhaiya very speciﬁc: HAR mandir ki baat nahi ho rahi — K UCH mandir aise hote hain.) 2. Jaise hi aap samarpan bhaav se pranam k arte ho, wahan k e doot (chahe doot ho ya pr et — kaam wahi k arte hain) "ashirwad r oop mein" aapk e peechhe ho jaate hain. 3. Ghar par Gurudev k a pahra hai, Hanuman Ji Maharaj k e doot khade hain — par entry k e time peechhe wale doot bolenge: "Isne humein pranam kiya tha, hum ashirwad swar oop aaye hain, yeh humein lek ar aaya hai." → Entry mil jaati hai → password ka access mil gaya. 4. Ek baar gaye ho to k oi badi baat nahi: ghar aak ar 2-3 din deepak lagaoge, prarthana k aroge, sab K alyan L ok chala jaayega — aap theek ho jaoge. 5. Problem DAIL Y jaane se hai (usi mandir mein): Jis pandit/shakti ne woh mandir sthapit kiya hai, woh daily apni shaktiyon ka aavahan karta hai (isiliye mandir chalta hai). Aavahan hote hi K alyan L ok bheji gayi shaktiyan wahan se chhootk ar wapas aa jaati hain — aur aap agle din phir mandir gaye, phir passwor d de diya. Ek cycle ban jaata hai. 6. Phir woh shakti sochti hai: "Y eh deepak/bhog Hanuman Ji Maharaj k o kyun ja raha hai, mujhe milna chahiye." Bhog to woh le nahi sakti (guru vachan ki wajah se deepak Hanuman Ji tak hi jaayega), par jo RETURN (return gift/urja) wapas aata hai, usk o woh password use karke attain kar leti hai. 7. Result: "Humne Baba k o deepak arpit kiye, Baba ne sweek ar hi nahi kiye" — nahi, wahan se sab aaya, r eturn bhi aaya, par tu jisk o lekar aa ya usi ne sab le liya. Aapk o yahan (Guru) se milne wali urja k ahin aur jaati hai, aur aapk a patan shuru ho jaata hai. Kya karna chahiye (correct behaviour / rules) Mandir jaana MANA NAHI hai. "Hum k abhi nahi k ehte mandir mat jao — jao, itne sundar mandir hain, alag-alag vidyayein hain, sant-mahatma hain, seekho ." Par apna Ram tattva mat bhoolo. Kabhi-kabhi jaana (15 din mein ek baar , hafte mein ek baar , 2-3 din mein ek baar , darshan k e liye) — koi dikk at nahi. Ghar aao, deepak lagao, shaktiyan aayengi-chali jaayengi. That's all.

Daily usi ek mandir mein jaana + samarpan bhaav se pranam = nuksaan. Sankalp lekar mandir jaate ho to koi dikk at nahi. Mandir mein sakshi maankar deepak jalana (us mandir ki shakti k o pranam kiye BINA) — bahut achhi baat hai, k oi dikk at nahi. Raaste mein bik e par mandir dekh k ar thoda jhukna / aadar dena — woh A ADAR hai, samarpan nahi; usse k uch nahi hota. Aadar zar oor dena — "main kisi k o nahi maanta" wali akad mein mat r ehna, war na toot jaoge. Sirf safai/seva karne jaate (mandir chamk ate) to bhi k oi dikk at nahi thi — gadbad "samarpan-bhaav wale pranam" se hoti hai. Ghar walon ke baare mein (FAQ se) Ghar wale (mummy -papa) daily mandir jaate hain → shaktiyan 100% ghar aa yengi , PAR jo mandir ja raha hai woh hi lek ar aayega aur wohi phansega — agar usk e paas aapka password nahi hai. Agar aapne mummy -papa k o apni vidhi NAHI batayi hai aur sirf aap hi k arte ho → chinta mat karo, access aapk e paas hi rahega. Aapk a deepak, aapk a jaap, aapki shakti aapk e paas rahegi. Agar vidhi bata di hai → unhe bolo mandir daily jaana band k ar dein, ya mentor se passwor d change k arvao . 5. GALTI #3 — HAR BHAGWAN KI POOJA / HAR MANTRA / SIDDHIYON KA SHAUK Kaun log Jinko har bhagwan ki pooja, har vidhi, har mantra, har vidya seekhne k a shauk hai: "Lakshmi mantra bhi aana chahiye, Bhairav k avach chahiye, Hanuman ji k a astra, Mata ki kripa, Ganesh bhagwan ki kripa, Dhumavati sadhna, yakshini/pishachini powerful hai..." Alag-alag sadhnayein k arke gyaan k a bhandaar banna chahte hain → phans jaate hain aur dhadaam se girte hain. Core concept: Siddhi ki Maintenance Cost Siddhi banana k oi bhi sikha dega (YouTube par sab milega: "8 din mein Hanuman siddhi", "Karna Pishachini", "Y akshini"...) — par siddhi k o MAINT AIN kaise karna hai, yeh k oi nahi sikhata. Yahi sabse badi galti hai. Har siddhi ki ek lifeline hoti hai aur ek maintaining cost hoti hai. Gaadi analogy (F ortuner): Fortuner 61 lakh mein aati hai, phir pehli servicing, doosri servicing, cleaning-denting-painting, 12-13 ki average — sab maintain k arna padta hai. Har

mahine nayi gaadi loge par servicing nahi k araoge to har gaadi fail ho jaayegi. Itni saari gaadiyan le loge to unk a bojh aur k arza — insaan usi bojh k e tale mar jaata hai. Yahi siddhi hai. Jitni badi sadhna, utni hi badi maintenance. 10 mahine ki sadhna ki maintenance cost bhi 10 mahine k e hisaab se rahegi. (F ortuner mein ₹10 k a petr ol daalwaoge to dhakk a bhi nahi lagega.) 6 mahine ki tapasya se bani siddhi k e baad dheele ho gaye → maintenance cost k aun dega? Siddhi maintain nahi rakhi to wahi pret bankar aapki jaan kha jaa yegi. Aise log urja banate r ehte hain aur urja waste hoti r ehti hai. Core concept: Ek Tattva Prabal Karo (Iron & Water analogy) Hypothetical e xample: maan lo Shiv tattva = iron (loha) , Ram tattva = jal (paani) . Koi sochta hai "mer e paas loha bhi hai, paani bhi — dono se k aam k arunga." Sunne mein achha lagta hai. Par koi drishti wala shaana vyakti aayega: loha thoda sa hai → chumbak (magnet) rakhega, loha khinch lega. P aani thoda sa hai → aag jalayega, paani udd jaayega. Dono siddhiyan gayin — peechhe bacha "baba ji ka thullu." PAR agar ek hi tattva par k aam kiya hota: 100 ton loha pada hai → hazaar on magnet rakh do, loha nahi khisk ega, ulta magnet khud khinchk ar lohe k e paas aa jaayega aur aisi chipk egi ki jaane k a naam nahi legi — saamne wale k o apna magnet wahin chhodk ar aana padega. Laakhon cubic cm jal hai → poor e planet ki aag bujha do . Hydraulic pump k a example: jo loha nahi utha sakta, woh paani k a pressur e utha leta hai; bade-bade ship/truck hydraulic se chalte hain. Moral: Laakhon alag-alag tattva banane se achha hai EK hi tattva k o prabal kar lo. Ek mantra rakho, ek devta rakho, ek tattva rakho — duniya mein aisa k oi kaam nahi jo sambhav na ho . Alag-alag mantr on se alag-alag sookshm sharir bante hain → alag-alag vulnerable conditions ban jaati hain ki aapk o har tattva se kheencha ja sak e. Core concept: Kripa vs Siddhi Kripa aur siddhi mein bahut fark hai. Kripa k e peechhe bhaago, siddhiyon k e peechhe nahi. Mat bolo "mer e paas Hanuman Ji ki siddhi hai" — bolo "mer e upar Hanuman Ji Maharaj ki KRIPA hai." Jo kripa-patra ban jaata hai use siddhiyon ki avashyakta nahi padti — usk e liye duniya ki saari shaktiyan k am ho jaati hain. (P atra = grahan shakti k a paatra.) Siddhi to bahut nimn (chhoti) cheez hai; kripa bahut badi hoti hai.

Aashray mein siddhi-system kaise kaam karta hai Aapk e paas jo shaktiyan/siddhiyan k aam k arti hain woh permanent nahi hotin — unki SHIFT chalti hai. Aaj k oi siddhi, k al koi aur . Zaroorat k e hisaab se "screen" di jaati hai: negativity dekhni hai to negativity ki scr een, devta darshan ki scr een, sharir k e ang dekhne ki scr een, bhavishya/past dekhne ki, santon se baat k arne ki — k aam hote hi wapas le li jaati hai. Gurudev ki kripa se shaktiyon ki continuous servicing hoti hai, continuous jagran chalta hai — tabhi shaktiyan channelize hoti hain. Siddhi ki maintenance k a yahi khar cha Aashray uthata hai. Isliye particular ek siddhi k abhi aapk e peechhe khadi nahi milegi. Kya karna chahiye Zyada mantr on mein mat ghuso — faayde mein rahoge. Jitni badi sadhna k ar rahe ho, usi k o continue rakho — jaise dharti k a paani add- on na ho to sookh jaata hai, waise hi naam-jaap continuously chalta r ehna chahiye. "T ry karo Ram k a naam chalta rahe." Do din jhatk a lagne par kisi k e behk ave mein aak ar mantra mat badlo ("aaj yeh mantra k ar lo, kal woh") — k ahin k e nahi rahoge. Aapk a kaam aap hi k o karna padega — chahe astral ho ya physical. Har vyakti aapk o push de sakta hai, access dila sakta hai, par k aarya aapk o khud k arna hai. 6. GALTI #4 — MANN-ICHCHHA CHALANA (Vidhi poori na karna) Kaun log Jo apne mann ki bahut chalate hain: bola gaya 10 din k aro, 5 din k arke soch liya "baaki baad mein; bhagwan k o sunna hoga to 5 din mein bhi sun lega." Jo time-period diya gaya, jo guru vachan diye gaye, unk o nahi nibhaate. Kya hota hai Shaktiyan k aam k arna band k ar deti hain. Dosh alag lagta hai. ("Shaktiyan aak ar thappad maar k e jaati hain" — bahut bura haal hota hai.) Especially danger ous: agar Mata k e tatvon/bhakton k e saath khilwaad k ar liya (kisi mandir/sadhak ne k uch upay bataya aur aapne poora nahi kiya) — Mata ki shaktiyan chhodti nahi hain, bahut zyada nuksaan k ar deti hain. Aap lene k uch gaye the, ho k uch aur gaya. Aashray/R am tattva wale to shaant hain (kisi par astra nahi uthate, haath jode rakhte hain), par har jagah aisa nahi hai.

85% / 15% ka observation More than 85% logon k e kaam k ehte hi ban rahe hain. Jo 15% k e nahi ho rahe, woh inhi galtiyon ki wajah se. Kuch log jhooth bhi bolte hain ki "humne sab kiya" — Gurudev bata dete hain ki jhooth bol rahe hain. Aashray unhe phir bhi aur upay batata hai, bina daante ("Aap humein nahi bataoge to humein k oi fark nahi padega — fark aapk o padega, shaktiyan aapk e saath rahengi"). Jo phir bhi theek nahi hote, unk e liye Gurudev k a uttar : "Beta, unka sama y nahi aa ya. Jab unka theek hone ka sama y aayega to apne aap kaarya ho jaa yega. Sama y nahi aa ya to intezaar karo." Kya karna chahiye Jo process bataya gaya hai, woh poora karo, jitna bola ga ya utna karo. Aashray k a process simple hai: k uch bhi khao -piyo, k abhi bhi sadhna/jaap/deepak k aro — bas continuously karo. Aashray k o mat do, apne ghar par lagao — bas Guru k a access/ashirwad hona chahiye. Chamatk ar hoga. 7. BONUS CASE — BAAR-BAAR GURU BADALNA Ek aur category : 6 mahine mein k aam nahi hua to naya guru — baar -baar guru change k arna. Normal cases mein zyada k uch nahi hota, P AR agar aap kisi ugra/powerful (very aggressive) shakti ke sadhak/guru k e paas the — jaise Mata ka tattva (sabse ugra), Hanuman Ji Maharaj k a tattva (thoda ugra) — aur wahan se nik al kar kisi aur k e paas aa gaye, to wahan ki shaktiyan aapk o chhodengi nahi; jeena haraam k ar dengi. ("T umhara guru ghantal ho jaayega.") Ram tattva bahut aaram se/shaant k aam k arta hai — isliye Aashray mein k oi bhi aaye ya jaaye, k oi kuch nahi k ehta. Tattva aggr ession scale (transcript k e hisaab se): Ram tattva = sabse shaant → Hanuman Ji Maharaj = thoda ugra → Mata = aur zyada ugra. 8. TATTVA CONCEPTS (FAQ se aaye clariﬁcations) Ek mahamantra, alag-alag tatva kaise? Base tattva wahi r ehta hai, baaki tatva usme mix hote hain. Jaise paani (R am/jal tattva) k e andar loha, minerals, agni, vayu mix ho sakte hain — paani garam ho jaata hai (agni tattva alter nate for m mein), par tattva paani hi rahega. Base k abhi nahi badalta. Vishnu ji k e alag roop (jaise Narasimha vs Ram): Fark to rahega — Narasimha bhagwan ka tattva alag aayega, R am k a alag. Hanuman Ji Maharaj Bholenath k e Rudra avatar hain —

tatva alag-alag hote hain. Ravan k e paas itni shakti isliye aayi thi (devta bhi darte the) — k yunki usne apna tattva prabal kiya tha. Jo yeh 4 galtiyan nahi k arta uski urja itni ho jaati hai ki brahmand ki kisi bhi shakti k o lalkaar sakta hai. 9. QUICK RULES SUMMARY (Chatbot ke liye ready-reference) KABHI MA T KARO: 1. Apni vidhi/mantra/sank alp/prarthana/ghar k e niyam kisi k o mat batao (passwor d leak). 2. Har mandir mein samarpan-bhaav se pranam/dandavat mat k aro; ek hi mandir mein daily mat jao . 3. Har devta ki siddhi/har mantra collect mat k aro; siddhi banao to maintenance mat bhoolo . 4. Batayi gayi vidhi adhoori mat chhodo; mann-ichchha mat chalao . 5. Baar-baar guru mat badlo (especially ugra shakti k e sadhak). BILKUL KAR SAKTE HO (yeh galat NAHI hai): 1. Kisi k o Aashray join k arne ke liye bolna/r efer karna — bas apni personal vidhi shar e mat k aro. 2. Mandir k abhi-k abhi darshan k e liye jaana (weekly/15 din mein) — ghar aak ar deepak laga lo . 3. Sank alp lek ar mandir jaana. 4. Mandir mein sakshi maank ar deepak jalana (us shakti k o samarpan-pranam kiye bina). 5. R aaste mein mandir dekh k ar aadar mein jhukna — aadar zar oor do . 6. Ghar walon k a daily mandir jaana (jab tak unhe aapki vidhi nahi pata). GALTI HO GA YI TO: - Apne mentor k o contact k aro → ghar k a password change karvao . Yahi ekmatra ﬁx hai. BHAA V/TONE: - Kripa k e peechhe bhaago, siddhi k e peechhe nahi. - Ek naam, ek devta, ek tattva — usk o prabal k aro, continuous rakho . - "Jai Siya R am" k a jap k arte raho . Apna R am tattva kabhi mat bhoolo .
